workshop.body: a toymaker elf's work outfit: a green elf tunic with a pointed zigzag collar and hem, a big tan canvas tool apron over it with a pencil in its pocket, a dark brown belt, and a little wooden toy mallet held in the right red mitten; red and cream striped tights and maroon curly toed elf shoes with gold bells
workshop.head: a red pointed elf hat with a zigzag green brim and a small gold jingle bell on its floppy tip

present.body: a costume that makes the wearer a wrapped Christmas present: a big square red box round the body tied with a wide gold ribbon, the arms in red sleeves with red mittens coming out of its sides, and red and cream striped tights and cream socks below it
present.head: a big shiny gold ribbon bow, worn on top of a head

pudding.body: a round Christmas pudding costume: a big round dark brown fruity pudding with white icing dripping over its top, brown sleeves with red mittens coming out of its sides, and red and cream striped tights and cream socks below it
pudding.head: a small sprig of holly with three red berries, worn on top of a head

snowman.body: a snowman costume: a round white fluffy snowball body with three coal black buttons and a red knitted scarf at its neck, white sleeves with red mittens, and red and cream striped tights and cream socks below it
snowman.head: a little black top hat with a red band, tilted to one side

piper.body: a Highland piper's outfit: a black jacket with silver buttons, a red tartan kilt with a white sporran, white kilt socks and black shoes, red mittens, and a set of bagpipes held under one arm
piper.head: a small black Scottish glengarry bonnet, a little boat shaped cap seen from the front, with a red and white diced band; short ribbons, nothing big

grad.body: graduation robes: a long black gown with gold trim down the front, red mittens, a rolled certificate tied with a red ribbon held in the right mitten, and cream socks at the bottom
grad.head: a black square mortar board graduation cap seen from the front: a flat black board on top of a black skull cap, with a gold tassel hanging at one side

golden.body: a golden detective outfit: a shining gold belted trench coat with a gold star badge, golden mittens holding a gold magnifying glass with a clear empty lens, and golden boots
golden.head: a shining gold checked detective's deerstalker hat with a little bow on top

tree.body: a Christmas tree costume: a layered green fir tree all in one, dotted with small baubles and a garland of little gold lights, a gold star on its top, red mittens poking out of its sides, and red and cream striped tights and cream socks below it

ginger.body: a gingerbread costume: a gingerbread biscuit onesie with white icing squiggles at the wrists and ankles and three sweet buttons down the front, and a close gingerbread hood with icing trim round the face

reindeer.body: a cosy reindeer onesie: soft brown fleece with a pale cream tummy patch, a hood with soft felt antlers and floppy reindeer ears, a shiny red pom pom on the hood like a red nose, and brown hoof slippers

nessie.body: a friendly Loch Ness monster costume: a green onesie with a dinosaur hood with friendly eyes and little spikes, a pale green tummy, a tail, and a blue tartan scarf
